asks.first: Isabelle says with a thoughtful look, "The Ballroom, with Sarah Jo, all evening. We were so deep in talk, I scarcely heard a sound from the rest of the house. I did not much like Jessica, but I did find Jessica fascinating. Is that a terrible thing to say?"
asks.repeat: "Let me say it once more, in case I missed something, the Ballroom, with Sarah Jo, all evening. We were so deep in talk, I scarcely heard a sound from the rest of the house. Is it as you expected?"

asks.first: Danny says angrily, "I sat alone in the Bedroom the whole evening, and a fine thing it is to be asked about it now. Jessica was a good friend once, and this makes my blood boil to think of."
asks.repeat: "Do keep up! As I said, alone! The Bedroom! All evening! What else do you want, a signed statement? Are we quite finished?"

asks.first: Carolyn says with curiosity, "I was in the Sewing room with Kwinn the whole evening. Does it help or hinder, being two? I can't decide. If it were me, I'd press John. Why would John take such an interest in Jessica's habits?"
asks.repeat: "Same as before, though I wonder why you ask twice, with Kwinn, in the Sewing room, the entire evening. I've been wondering since what the others were doing. Haven't you? Is it as you expected?"

asks.first: John stammers, "Danny and I were together in the Bedroom, all evening, I mean the whole of it. I'm sure about that, quite sure. Poor Jessica. I mean it's terrible, of course, but I'd be fibbing if I said I knew what to feel."
asks.repeat: "I did say, I mean I'm sure I said it, I was in the Bedroom, with Danny, the entire evening... I mean we were together, never apart, not once. There's nothing else, I mean really nothing."

asks.first: Kwinn says with a smile, "I sat with Carolyn in the Sewing room all evening long, and we talked until the whole dreadful business began. I hardly knew Jessica well enough to grieve properly, and I feel dreadful about that."
asks.repeat: "Of course, dear, I'll say it again, I was with Carolyn in the Sewing room the whole evening, and I'm so glad of the company, tonight of all nights. I do wish I had more to offer you."

asks.first: Sarah Jo says with a smile, "Why, Isabelle was with me in the Ballroom the entire evening. We never parted for a minute. I keep thinking of Jessica laughing at supper. It seems such a short while ago."
asks.repeat: "Why, certainly, once more, I was with Isabelle in the Ballroom the whole evening, and I'm so glad of the company, tonight of all nights. I do wish I had more to offer you."
